directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90. The row to open is /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90. Bend 90° / R275. Nominal diameter DN200. Put /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90 in the subject. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90. The section title “Example - Stockpile Volume in Metric Units” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管的数字。要打开的行是 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90。公称直径 DN200.弯曲 90° / R275.主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90 开始。河北品锦机械在邢台把DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管列在 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90。节标题「示例 - Stockpile 体积 在 公制单位」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.en: Example - Stockpile Volume in Metric Units
heading.zh: 示例 - Stockpile 体积 在 公制单位

body.en: “Example - Stockpile Volume in Metric Units” titles this part of the Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90 note. The figures stay the printed ones. Bend 90° / R275. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90.
body.zh: 「示例 - Stockpile 体积 在 公制单位」是DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。弯曲 90° / R275.OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90 开始。

heading.en: Example - Stockpile Volume in Imperial Units
heading.zh: 示例 - Stockpile 体积 在 英制单位

body.en: For Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90, the heading “Example - Stockpile Volume in Imperial Units” does not replace a cell. Nominal diameter DN200. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90.
body.zh: 对DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管而言，标题「示例 - Stockpile 体积 在 英制单位」并不替换任何格子。河北品锦机械在邢台把DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管列在 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90。公称直径 DN200.

body.en: Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90 is unchanged by the heading “Mass of a Pile”. Put /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90 in the subject. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/stockpile-volume-d_1532.html.
body.zh: DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管不因标题「质量的Pile」而改动。主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/stockpile-volume-d_1532.html。

question.en: Does “Example - Stockpile Volume in Metric Units” replace Bend 90° / R275?
question.zh: 「示例 - Stockpile 体积 在 公制单位」会替换「公称直径 DN200」吗？

answer.en: No. Bend 90° / R275 remains the printed wording for Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90.
answer.zh: 不会。公称直径 DN200仍是DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Nominal diameter DN200 belong on the Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90 row?
question.zh: DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管这一行里，「弯曲 90° / R275」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Example - Stockpile Volume in Imperial Units” add to Concrete Pump Elbow DN200 90?
question.zh: 「示例 - Stockpile 体积 在 英制单位」给DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/stockpile-volume-d_1532.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/stockpile-volume-d_1532.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Bend 90° / R275?
question.zh: 「公称直径 DN200」旁边印了标价吗？
